items.why: Oil hit a five-month high as Middle East tensions rose, per WSJ and Investopedia live coverage.
Tech bounced while the Dow and S&P fell, with MarketWatch noting the Nasdaq gaining as tech stocks recovered.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape.
The Dow tumbled more than 500 points as Middle East tensions rose and selling broadened beyond tech, per CNBC.

market_note: Mixed tape: Dow and S&P futures lower, Nasdaq futures green, oil higher, gold softer.
summary: Stocks are split mid-morning Friday with the Dow down hard on rising Middle East tensions while the Nasdaq is up on a tech bounce. Oil jumped to a five-month high and gold pulled back.
